jobs.description:
**Why qlub**

The end of a great meal shouldn't be the slow part. Waiting for the check, finding someone to take payment, splitting a bill by hand. qlub removes that friction. Guests scan a QR code and pay in seconds. No app, no download, no waiting.

From Pay-at-Table and Digital Menus to Order-and-Pay, Payment Links, and SoftPOS terminals, we handle the full payment experience so restaurants can focus on what they do best: great hospitality. Less friction means faster table turnover, smoother operations, and higher profit.

We're a fast-scaling fintech backed by Mastercard, Mubadala, e& and Shorooq. $72M raised, live across multiple markets worldwide, and headcount doubled in the past year. We're building the teams that take us to the next stage.

**The role**

We need a Senior Data Engineer to own our data platform. Today it runs on GCP: BigQuery as the warehouse, dbt for modelling, Airflow for orchestration, and ClickHouse where we need low-latency analytics. It feeds internal reporting, merchant-facing analytics, and a growing set of AI-assisted tooling.

This is a hands-on job. Most of your week is building and running pipelines, fixing what breaks, and making the data trustworthy enough that people stop double-checking it. You will also set the standards the rest of the team follows and mentor the engineers around you.

You do not need to have used every tool listed below. You do need to have run production data systems and know what goes wrong with them.

AGS Academys is an online learning and career development platform focused on providing industry-oriented technical training to students, graduates, and aspiring IT professionals. We emphasize practical learning, real-world projects, and career development to prepare learners for opportunities in the technology industry.

Job Description

We are looking for a passionate and skilled **AI Developer Mentor** who can train, guide, and mentor aspiring AI developers.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of Python programming, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and AI application development. The candidate should be capable of explaining complex AI concepts through practical examples and guiding students in building real-world AI-powered applications.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct live online training sessions on Artificial Intelligence.
* Teach Python programming for AI development.
* Explain AI, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning fundamentals.
* Introduce data preprocessing and exploratory data analysis.
* Teach essential machine learning algorithms and their applications.
* Guide students in using libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, and TensorFlow or PyTorch.
* Introduce Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Guide students in building AI-powered applications using APIs.
* Introduce prompt engineering and AI integration.
* Guide students through practical AI projects and assignments.
